preconditions.description: The input integer n is between 3 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) == n and all(len(row) == n for row in lines)
preconditions.description: The parsed output consists of exactly n lines, each containing exactly n characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'WB' for line in lines for c in line)
preconditions.description: Every character in the output grid is either 'W' or 'B'.

postconditions.description: The number of duels in the output grid equals the maximum possible number of duels for an n x n board.

postconditions.expression: duels == sum(1 for r1 in range(n) for c1 in range(n) for r2 in range(n) for c2 in range(n) if is_knight_attack(r1, c1, r2, c2) and grid[r1][c1] != grid[r2][c2]) // 2
postconditions.description: The duel count is calculated as the number of unordered pairs of cells (r1, c1) and (r2, c2) such that the knights attack each other and have different colors.
